response_property_constraints.description: Each item's available_markets must be a list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (two uppercase letters).
The object type of every track item must be 'track'.
The object type of every artist within each track must be 'artist'.
The Spotify URI of each track must have the form 'spotify:track:<id>' and its id part must match the track's id.
When not null, preview_url must be a URL starting with http:// or https://.
The disc number must be a positive integer (usually 1).
The track number must be a positive integer (number on the specified disc).
The track length in milliseconds must be a non-negative integer.
The next field is a URL to the next page of items, or null if there is none. It must be non-null only if offset + number of items returned is less than total, and null otherwise.
The previous field is a URL to the previous page of items, or null if none. It must be null when offset is 0 and a URL when offset is greater than 0.
The total number of items available must be a non-negative integer and at least offset plus the number of items returned.
The number of items returned must not exceed the page limit reported in the response.
